description: Human-verified golden dataset for LLM customer support classification and summarization evaluation.

test_cases.input: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription. Can you refund the duplicate payment?

expected_output.summary: The customer was charged twice for their subscription and wants a refund for the duplicate payment.

test_cases.input: The application crashes every time I try to upload a PDF document.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports that the application crashes when uploading a PDF document.

test_cases.input: I forgot my password and cannot log into my account.

expected_output.summary: The customer cannot access their account because they forgot their password.

test_cases.input: What are your customer support hours?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking about customer support operating hours.

test_cases.input: My card was charged but my subscription still says it is unpaid.

expected_output.summary: The customer was charged but their subscription still shows as unpaid.

test_cases.input: The website loads normally but the checkout button does nothing when I click it.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports that the checkout button does not respond when clicked.

test_cases.input: Please change the email address associated with my account.

expected_output.summary: The customer wants to change the email address associated with their account.

test_cases.input: I would like to know if you offer student discounts.

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking whether student discounts are available.

test_cases.input: I can't sign in because the verification code never arrives. I've tried five times!

expected_output.summary: The customer cannot sign in because they are not receiving the verification code.

test_cases.input: I was charged €49.99 and I don't recognize this payment.

expected_output.summary: The customer does not recognize a €49.99 charge on their account.

test_cases.notes: Potential unauthorized or unexpected billing charge.

test_cases.input: Why did my subscription price increase this month?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking why their subscription price increased.

test_cases.input: I need an invoice for my latest payment.

expected_output.summary: The customer is requesting an invoice for their latest payment.

test_cases.input: Can I get a refund for my subscription?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking for a subscription refund.

test_cases.input: My payment keeps getting declined even though my card works elsewhere.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports that their payment is repeatedly being declined.

test_cases.input: I paid for the upgrade but my account still shows the old plan.

expected_output.summary: The customer paid for a plan upgrade but their account still shows the old plan.

test_cases.input: There is a €9.99 charge on my card that I don't remember making.

expected_output.summary: The customer does not recognize a €9.99 charge on their card.

test_cases.input: I cancelled my subscription last week, so why was I charged again?

expected_output.summary: The customer was charged after cancelling their subscription.

test_cases.input: My bank says the payment went through, but your website says the transaction failed.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports a mismatch between their bank payment status and the website transaction status.

test_cases.input: I was billed for something I never ordered.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports being billed for an item they did not order.

test_cases.input: Can you explain what this charge on my statement is?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking for an explanation of a charge on their statement.

test_cases.input: The app freezes whenever I open the settings page.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports that the app freezes when opening the settings page.

test_cases.input: I cannot upload my profile picture.

expected_output.summary: The customer cannot upload their profile picture.

test_cases.input: The dashboard is completely blank after I log in.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports that the dashboard appears blank after logging in.

test_cases.input: The export button gives me an error every time.

expected_output.summary: The customer receives an error whenever they try to export data.

test_cases.input: Notifications stopped working after the latest update.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports that notifications stopped working after the latest update.

test_cases.notes: Technical issue linked to a software update.

test_cases.input: The page takes forever to load and sometimes eventually crashes.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports extremely slow page loading followed by occasional crashes.

test_cases.input: I can log in on my phone but the desktop application keeps showing an error.

expected_output.summary: The customer can log in on their phone but receives an error in the desktop application.

test_cases.input: The search worked yesterday but now returns no results for anything.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports that the search function has stopped returning results.

test_cases.input: It worked perfectly until I updated the app, and now every screen is lagging.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports severe performance problems after updating the app.

test_cases.input: The payment page says my card is invalid, but I can see the money was already taken from my account.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports an invalid-card message despite money already being deducted from their account.

test_cases.notes: Intentionally tests billing versus technical classification; billing is the expected primary category.

test_cases.input: I forgot my username.

expected_output.summary: The customer has forgotten their username.

test_cases.input: How do I reset my password?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking how to reset their password.

test_cases.input: Please delete my account.

expected_output.summary: The customer wants to delete their account.

test_cases.input: I changed my phone number and need to update it on my profile.

expected_output.summary: The customer wants to update the phone number associated with their profile.

test_cases.input: Why did you lock me out? I entered the correct password!

expected_output.summary: The customer reports being locked out despite entering what they believe is the correct password.

test_cases.notes: Account access problem with conflicting password information.

test_cases.input: My verification email never arrives, so I can't finish setting up my account.

expected_output.summary: The customer cannot complete account setup because the verification email is not arriving.

test_cases.input: Someone changed the email address on my account and now I can't access it.

expected_output.summary: The customer reports an unauthorized email change that has prevented account access.

test_cases.input: Can I use two different email addresses with the same account?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking whether an account can have two email addresses.

test_cases.input: login not working

expected_output.summary: The customer reports that they cannot log into their account.

test_cases.notes: Very short input with minimal context.

test_cases.input: Ich kann mich nicht anmelden und bekomme keinen Bestätigungscode.

expected_output.summary: The customer cannot sign in because they are not receiving a verification code.

test_cases.input: What countries do you currently support?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking which countries are currently supported.

test_cases.input: Do you have a mobile app?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking whether a mobile app is available.

test_cases.input: Where can I find your terms and conditions?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking where to find the terms and conditions.

test_cases.input: Is there a free trial?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking whether a free trial is available.

test_cases.input: Can I change my plan whenever I want?

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking whether they can change their subscription plan at any time.

test_cases.input: Your service looks interesting, but I want to know what features are included in the premium plan.

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking which features are included in the premium plan.

test_cases.input: wow great, another update that breaks everything 🙄

expected_output.summary: The customer sarcastically reports that an update has caused problems.

test_cases.input: Hallo, ich möchte wissen, ob es einen Studentenrabatt gibt.

expected_output.summary: The customer is asking whether a student discount is available.

test_cases.input: I was charged twice AND I can't log in to check my invoice.

expected_output.summary: The customer was charged twice and cannot log in to check their invoice.

test_cases.notes: Multiple issues; billing is the primary issue.

test_cases.input: Nothing works. Please help.

expected_output.summary: The customer is requesting help without providing enough information to identify a specific issue.
